speaker: william_shakespeare
text: There is a thing about what a Master of the Revels can hear, and what he cannot.

speaker: richard_field
text: Is this a thing written, a thing rumoured, or a thing thou knowest?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It is a thing I fear.

speaker: richard_field
text: And my Holinshed is neither written, rumoured nor known, but lent.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The printer is the only one of his friends who can be got rid of in under a minute.

speaker: richard_field
text: The book is the small Italian one. I am not asking its title in the hall.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: There is no title I am giving it. Take it. The stair is yours to leave.
